title: Meeting transcripts: who can create them, where they live and who can read them
summary: The documented controls, defaults, licensing and storage rules are supported. Minor corrections should acknowledge conflicting PowerShell reference notes, remove questions answered elsewhere in Microsoft's documentation, and align the storage checklist with the controls table.

claims.where: Open questions: retention labels and expiration
claims.claim: The cited pages do not explain the interaction between auto-apply retention labels and transcript expiration.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams recording transcripts auto apply retention label expiration retention priority. Read the cited storage, expiration and sensitive-meetings pages; also read manage-teams-recording-compliance and retention-policies-sharepoint, which explain retention taking precedence.
claims.fix: Remove the open question beginning 'How does an auto-apply retention label policy interact'. Microsoft answers it elsewhere: https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/manage-teams-recording-compliance explains retention versus expiration, and https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/retention-policies-sharepoint says permanent deletion is suspended while another retention policy or label requires retention. No replacement paragraph is needed.

claims.fix: Remove the open question beginning 'Which Microsoft Entra permission names'. The permissions are documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/calltranscript-get?view=graph-rest-1.0, including OnlineMeetingTranscript.Read.All and application permission OnlineMeetingTranscript.Read.Chat with its documented scope. No replacement paragraph is needed.
